title: Rider Availability, Election Window and Effective Date Terms
content:
The enrollment terms each of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders is sold on.

## 1. What each rider covers, and how many a member may hold

| Rider | What the rider covers | Riders one member may hold at once |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | dental | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | vision | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | hearing | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | dental | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | dental | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | dental, vision and hearing together | 1 |

## 2. Medical plan tiers each rider may be attached to

| Rider | Medical plan tiers the rider is sold with |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS), Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS), Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS), Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO), Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS), Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS), Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS), Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO), Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) |

## 3. Election window and effective date

| Rider | Days from the start of the medical plan within which the rider may be added outside the annual election period | Rule turning an accepted request into a start date |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 31 | the first of the month following the request |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 31 | the first of the month following the request |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 31 | the first of the month following the request |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 31 | the first of the month following the request |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 31 | the first of the month following the request |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 31 | the first of the month following the request |

The election window of 31 calendar days and the effective date rule are the same on all six riders.

## 4. Note on availability

Three riders are sold on all six Ridgecrest Advantage tiers; the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider and the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider on five, the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider on four, and the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider on three. The bundle rider is the single rider in the schedule a member may hold only one of.
